points.description: First benefit correctly named/identified AND explained with its reason, e.g. reduced switch complexity (switches only follow flow tables, no local routing decisions); or faster convergence to global optimum via centralized global view; or better application/network integration; or increased flexibility (routing logic updatable on the fly, programmable via API/high-level languages).
points.partial_credit: Benefit named correctly but reason/explanation missing or vague (or only reason without clear benefit) earns half of this point.

points.description: Second, different benefit from the model answer's list, correctly named AND explained with its reason (must not be a restatement of P1).
points.partial_credit: Benefit named correctly but reason/explanation missing or vague earns half of this point.

points.description: First drawback correctly named AND explained, e.g. control server complexity/bottleneck since it makes all routing decisions; centralized control as single point of failure with replication causing synchronization/consistency issues (CAP); adoption challenges (migration cost, personnel training, ROI); security concerns (loss of hardware security of physical routers/switches).
points.partial_credit: Drawback named correctly but reason/explanation missing or vague earns half of this point.

points.description: Second, different drawback from the model answer's list, correctly named AND explained (must not be a restatement of P3).
points.partial_credit: Drawback named correctly but reason/explanation missing or vague earns half of this point.

rubric.notes: Full marks need exactly two distinct benefits and two distinct drawbacks from the model answer, each with both the item and its reason. A bare label or a generic claim like "SDN is better/easier" earns nothing for that point; a named item with weak explanation earns half. A wrong statement within a point (e.g. listing a drawback as a benefit, or saying switches make routing decisions in SDN) cancels that point; do not credit benefits or drawbacks beyond two per category.
